transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

I’m here because I’ve been feeling really strange when I’m walking across campus. It’s like I’m watching everything through glass—I don’t feel fully in my own body, and the buildings and students around me seem slightly unreal. That’s what scares me most.
When these feelings happen, do you also experience sudden physical sensations like a racing heart, trembling, or shortness of breath?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed those kinds of physical symptoms when it happens.
Have you ever experienced or witnessed an extremely traumatic event, such as serious violence, severe injury, or a threat to your life?
No, I can’t think of anything like that happening to me or that I’ve witnessed.
Have you used any recreational drugs, such as marijuana or other substances, around the time these feelings began?
I’m not sure what you mean by recreational drugs. I haven’t really connected anything like that to when these feelings started.
During these moments when everything seems unreal, do you realize that it is just a feeling, or do you truly believe that reality itself has changed?

I know it’s a feeling, I think. But when I’m walking across campus, it’s scary—it’s like I’m looking at everything through glass. I don’t feel fully in my own body, and the buildings and students seem slightly unreal.
